2124670768680501697.en_summary: @StockSavvyShay came out of $NVDA earnings still seeing no signs of an AI overbuild, with compute fully utilized, Hopper GPUs recontracting at ~2x original pricing, and cloud backlog growing another $500B. Hard to reconcile with market pricing in a peak as customers are prepaying billions for capacity; unlike past overbuilds where sellers financed demand, this time buyers are financing supply.
